cipher.summary: Switched chat-interpretation/tools/meechie-studio-text's provider-config preflight from AppConfigSeam (too broad — throws if any unrelated app-wide field is absent) to ImageProviderConfigSeam (narrowly validates only xaiApiKey, defaulting its other fields), fixing a false-503 regression on deployments without image-specific env vars set; 661 tests pass, verify chain clean.
cipher.risks: No live-traffic validation (no XAI_API_KEY in this environment); this is the second same-session regression caught by automated review, suggesting fixes made under review-response time pressure should get a slower second look at their dependencies' actual preconditions before pushing.
